run_gen_gtest_pred_impl: run gen_gtest_pred_impl.py with a max arity integer to generate gtest predicate assertion header and unit test files
generate_header: generate the gtest_pred_impl.h header file with predicate assertion macros for a given maximum arity
generate_unittest: generate the gtest_pred_impl_unittest.cc unit test file with tests for predicate assertions up to a given arity
implementation_for_arity: generate C++ template implementation code for n-ary predicate assertion helper functions and macros
tests_for_arity: generate C++ unit test code covering all combinations of predicate assertion macros for a given arity
